title: US in possession of exotic material

tellings.quote: it is my uh belief that the United States is in possession of uh of exotic material

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who says he ran a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, is heard on Jesse Michels's podcast saying he believes the United States has exotic material in its possession. No time or place is given. If true, it would mean the government holds physical pieces of something not made by us.
